136:t_016:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No enemy can stand before the Diffusion Structure Phase Transition Cannon and me, the one who wields it...!」

136:t_016:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In light of the results, I'll agree with you this once.」

136:t_017:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Bring it on, $$サイデリアル$$! No matter how many you send out, my $$紅蓮$$ and I will knock them all out of the sky!」

136:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You're more fired up than usual, $$カレン$$.」

136:t_017:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Of course I am! This is my hometown!」

136:t_018:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「(I once wiped this city out with $$フレイヤ$$...)」

136:t_018:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「(I'll atone for that now...! I won't let this city be burned a second time!)」

136:t_019:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「As expected of the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon. It's earned its place as the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s signature weapon.」

136:t_019:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's keep this momentum going! We'll drive off the $$サイデリアル$$ in one push!」

136:t_020:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Like a moth flying into a flame, weren't you, $$サイデリアル$$.」

136:t_020:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have units here that show their true worth against large numbers of enemies.」

136:t_021:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-impossible...! I won't accept this outcome!」

136:t_021:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Remember this, $c, $$ゼロ$$! I'll repay this humiliation ten-thousandfold, without fail!」

136:t_022:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What do you mean, you won't accept it? The fight was already decided by the time you came waltzing in!」

136:t_022:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But that type of man is persistent. He'll surely come at us again.」

136:t_022:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then I'll show him the difference in class as many times as it takes. Until it gets through even his head.」

136:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$ゼロ$$! If only you didn't exist...!」

136:t_100:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A commander who fights over a personal grudge won't have his soldiers following him.」

136:t_100:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! I'll shut that mouth of yours for good right now!」

136:t_100:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Your mask has slipped, $$ギルター$$. Forcing your way through out of hatred for me... In the end, you're nothing but a petty villain who's only clever in small ways.」

136:t_100:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! Silence, damn you! You...!!」

136:t_100:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you're ready to be shot, come! I'll take you down with my own hands!」

136:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If you hadn't shown up back there, none of this would have happened!」

136:t_101:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you want to put it that way, all you had to do was not invade Earth.」

136:t_101:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You and your back talk!」

136:t_101:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking with you any longer. Disappear.」

136:t_102:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Too bad, small fry! Looks like you were no match for $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_102:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! The fight isn't over yet!」

136:t_102:2.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I pity the soldiers used by an incompetent commander who doesn't even know when to retreat!」

136:t_102:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well then, let's wrap this up quick so the damage doesn't spread any further!」

136:t_103:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「The outcome has already been decided. If you don't want any more needless sacrifices, withdraw your forces.」

136:t_103:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Do you mean to show pity to me... to $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!?」

136:t_103:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That's not it. I just want to keep Tokyo from becoming a battlefield as far as possible.」

136:t_103:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then it's punishment for insulting me! I'll reduce this city to ashes!」

136:t_103:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「If that's how you want it, we will fight you thoroughly! To cut off the root of the fighting!」

136:t_104:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I take you for the unit commander! By the book, I'll strike you down!」

136:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A man who can't even gauge his enemy's strength is in command, huh...!」

136:t_104:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! Do you mean to mock me!」

136:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When you've seen a man who served as the Leader and a pilot at the same time, it's only natural to think so!」

136:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I take this guy down, the battle is decided!」

136:t_105:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Would a brat who mistakes courage for recklessness be any match for me!」

136:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Looks like you don't know what happens on the battlefield to someone who thinks they're better than their opponent!」

136:t_106:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I don't like it. A pure white machine doesn't suit my battlefield.」

136:t_106:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Dyeing it red with your blood and flames might be fun, too.」

136:t_106:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That pushiness...! It isn't pleasant to listen to!」

136:t_106:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If a man like this is in command, we have an opening to exploit!」

136:t_107:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$! If I take this one down, it'll make a great gift!」

136:t_107:1.en:
$n
「I didn't get my $$スフィア$$ so that you could take the credit!」

136:t_107:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then learn your place! An ordinary man like you has no right to hold a $$スフィア$$!」

136:t_107:3.en:
$n
「An ordinary man, huh... That title suits an incompetent commander far better.」

136:t_107:5.en:
$n
「This power was given to me by many people! Words from the likes of you won't shake me!」

136:t_108:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If only you hadn't come...!」

136:t_108:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「This is my hometown! You're the ones who shouldn't have come!」

136:t_108:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't forgive you! If you try to burn this country, this city we worked so hard to rebuild, I'll be your opponent!」

136:t_108:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm $$紅月カレン$$! One of the $$黒の騎士団$$, who protect the peace!!」
